topic: Remove duplicates in 2 clicks
notes: Excel: Data > Remove Duplicates; Sheets: Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates; formula option =UNIQUE()

topic: Checkbox to-do list that crosses itself out
notes: Insert > Checkbox (Sheets; Excel 365 recent builds); conditional formatting strikethrough when box is TRUE

topic: Insert today's date and time instantly
notes: Ctrl+; date, Ctrl+Shift+; time in both; static values unlike =TODAY()

topic: SUMIFS: total sales by person and month
notes: =SUMIFS(sum_range, crit_range1, crit1, crit_range2, crit2); same in both

topic: Hide ugly #N/A and #DIV/0! errors
notes: =IFERROR(formula, ""); warn: can hide real mistakes

topic: Jump to the end of your data in 1 keystroke
notes: Ctrl+Arrow jumps to edge, Ctrl+Shift+Arrow selects; Cmd on Mac

topic: FILTER: a live filtered table with one formula
notes: =FILTER(A2:D10, C2:C10="Sales"); both; spills

topic: Why your lookup fails: hidden spaces
notes: =TRIM(A2) removes extra spaces; show lookup failing then working

topic: Highlight the whole row, not just one cell
notes: Conditional formatting custom formula =$D2>70000; dollar sign locks the column

topic: Combine a list into one cell with commas
notes: =TEXTJOIN(", ", TRUE, A2:A10); both

topic: F4: lock a cell reference with $
notes: Toggles A1 > $A$1 > A$1 > $A1; Excel Windows F4, Mac Cmd+T; Sheets F4

topic: COUNTIFS: count with two conditions
notes: =COUNTIFS(C2:C10,"Sales",D2:D10,">60000"); both

topic: Make a dropdown list in 10 seconds
notes: Excel: Data > Data Validation > List; Sheets: Insert > Dropdown

topic: SORT formula: the one difference that trips people
notes: Excel SORT(array,index,-1) vs Sheets SORT(range,col,FALSE) for descending

topic: Paste values only (no formulas, no formatting)
notes: Excel Ctrl+Alt+V then V; Sheets Ctrl+Shift+V; Cmd on Mac

topic: Count unique values with one formula
notes: =COUNTA(UNIQUE(A2:A100)); both (Excel 365/2021+)

topic: Split full names into first and last
notes: Excel Ctrl+E Flash Fill or TEXTSPLIT; Sheets =SPLIT(A2," ") or Data > Split text to columns

topic: Count business days between two dates
notes: =NETWORKDAYS(start,end,holidays); both

topic: Keep your header visible while scrolling
notes: View > Freeze (panes/top row in Excel; 1 row in Sheets)

topic: INDEX MATCH explained in 20 seconds
notes: =INDEX(A2:A5, MATCH(1063, B2:B5, 0)); works in old Excel too

topic: Tiny charts inside a cell
notes: Sheets =SPARKLINE(B2:M2); Excel Insert > Sparklines > Line

topic: Percent change the right way
notes: =(new-old)/old, format as %; common mistake old/new

topic: Fix ALL CAPS names in one go
notes: =PROPER(A2), also UPPER/LOWER; then paste values

topic: IF with AND / OR in plain English
notes: =IF(AND(B2>=70,C2="Yes"),"Pass","Fail"); both

topic: Turn a table into a heatmap
notes: Conditional formatting > Color scale; both

topic: Calculate age or tenure from a date
notes: =DATEDIF(A2,TODAY(),"Y"); works in both (undocumented in Excel)

topic: Fill a formula down 10,000 rows instantly
notes: Double-click the fill handle; Ctrl+D fills down a selection; both
